caption: The drawing features a rectangular section in the center of a larger, off-white background. Within the rectangle, the dominant color is a deep, solid blue. Arranged inside this blue area are multiple repeated, evenly spaced, eye-shaped or almond-shaped motifs. Each motif consists of three colored regions: an inner oval of either green, red, or brown, surrounded by an intermediate layer of a contrasting color, and an outer pointed, leaf-like border that is either yellow, red, or green at one end and white at the opposite pointed end. The motifs are organized in a grid-like, staggered pattern, with a total of fifteen motifs distributed in five rows of three. The composition is simple, with all elements contained within the blue rectangle, leaving the surrounding off-white background plain and unadorned.
title: Printed Textile
